# Security Finding: Unsafe YAML Deserialization

## Description
The `load_user_config` function in `config/load_config.py` uses `yaml.load` with the default `yaml.Loader`. This configuration is vulnerable to unsafe deserialization because `yaml.Loader` can instantiate arbitrary Python objects, potentially leading to Remote Code Execution (RCE) if an attacker can control the input string.

## Remediation
Replace the use of `yaml.load` with `yaml.safe_load`. The `safe_load` function restricts deserialization to standard YAML types (inteals, strings, lists, etc.), preventing the instantiation of complex Python objects and mitigating the risk of arbitrary code execution.
